knownSchemaGaps.javaDerivation: agent-core-java Workflow sets isStreaming=true when a component declares responseMode=streaming (Workflow.java:356-357); the N01 end node is streaming
knownSchemaGaps.note: attributed on 2026-09-12 as a probe defect, not a runtime difference; kept as a gating field
knownSchemaGaps.resolution: the deployed openjiuwen Workflow stores the flag in the private _is_streaming attribute (openjiuwen/core/workflow/workflow.py:241 in the deployed image, set by Workflow.set_end_comp when response_mode == "streaming") and exposes no public is_streaming accessor, so the superseded probe returned the default false for every workflow; the deployed IRConverter does pass response_mode="streaming" for an end node whose configs.isStreamOut is true (jiuwen/serve/controllers/execution/ir_converter.py:2618-2622), so the runtime flag is true. The corrected probe reads _is_streaming and reports true, and workflowStreaming was the only field that changed between the superseded and the corrected golden
